modalities.label: Looming threat (throw rock)
modalities.description: An object on a collision course. LC4 encodes angular velocity and LPLC2 angular size; both converge on the Giant Fibre DNp01.
modalities.citation: von Reyn et al. 2017, Nat Neurosci 20:1176; Klapoetke et al. 2017, Nature 551:237
modalities.notes: Driven through receptive fields derived from real FlyWire column assignments. See brain/sensory/encoders.py.

modalities.label: Light (photoreceptors R1-6)
modalities.description: Direct activation of the 8,456 real R1-6 photoreceptors.
modalities.citation: Rister et al. 2007, Neuron 56:155 (R1-6 -> L1/L2 pathway)
modalities.unsupported_reason: Photoreceptors are HISTAMINERGIC and their synapse onto lamina neurons is INHIBITORY (sign-inverting). FlyWire predicts only six neurotransmitters (ACh, GABA, Glu, DA, 5-HT, OA) and histamine is not among them, so R1-6 are mis-assigned as excitatory. Driving them would invert the sign of the entire early visual pathway. Modelling light this way would be wrong, so it is disabled.

modalities.label: Sugar on proboscis
modalities.description: Sugar-sensing gustatory receptor neurons. Drives the feeding circuit and proboscis extension.
modalities.citation: Engert et al. 2022, eLife 11:e78110; Shiu et al. 2024, Nature 634:210
modalities.notes: These neurons carry FlyWire labels contributed by Philip Shiu (Kristin Scott Lab), the reference model's own author. Only left-side sugar GRNs are labelled in v783.

modalities.label: Bitter on proboscis
modalities.description: Bitter gustatory receptor neurons. Suppresses feeding and drives proboscis retraction.

modalities.label: Food odour (apple cider vinegar)
modalities.description: Attractive food odour. Activates the glomeruli that mediate vinegar attraction.
modalities.citation: Semmelhack & Wang 2009, Nature 459:218; Hallem & Carlson 2006, Cell 125:143

modalities.label: Danger odour (geosmin)
modalities.description: Geosmin signals harmful microbes and drives innate avoidance through a single dedicated glomerulus, DA2.

modalities.label: Pheromone (cVA)
modalities.description: cis-vaccenyl acetate, the male-derived social pheromone.

modalities.label: CO2 (avoidance)
modalities.description: Carbon dioxide, an innately aversive stress odour.

modalities.label: Wind / air puff
modalities.description: Sustained antennal deflection by airflow, detected by the static-deflection subgroups of Johnston's organ.
modalities.citation: Yorozu et al. 2009, Nature 458:201; Kamikouchi et al. 2009, Nature 458:165

modalities.label: Sound / courtship song
modalities.description: Antennal vibration. JO-A and JO-B are the sound-sensitive subgroups; they also project to the Giant Fibre.

modalities.label: Touch: HEAD
modalities.description: Mechanosensory bristles of the head capsule: interommatidial, antennal, orbital, ocellar, frontal, vibrissae, maxillary palp and haustellum. Drives grooming.
modalities.citation: Hampel et al. 2015, eLife 4:e08758; Seeds et al. 2014, eLife 3:e02951

modalities.label: Leg contact chemosensation (tarsus)
modalities.description: Tarsal gustatory receptor neurons on the foreleg: what the fly tastes when it steps on food.

modalities.label: Touch: THORAX
modalities.unsupported_reason: Thoracic bristle mechanosensory neurons project to the ventral nerve cord. FlyWire FAFB v783 contains the brain only, so these neurons are absent from the dataset.

modalities.label: Touch: ABDOMEN
modalities.unsupported_reason: Abdominal mechanosensory neurons project to the ventral nerve cord and are absent from FlyWire FAFB v783 (brain only).

modalities.label: Touch: LEG (mechanical)
modalities.unsupported_reason: Leg bristle and campaniform mechanosensory neurons terminate in the ventral nerve cord and are absent from FlyWire FAFB v783. Leg CHEMOsensation is available separately: the tarsal gustatory neurons do ascend to the brain.

modalities.label: Cold
modalities.description: Cold-activated thermoreceptor neurons of the arista, projecting to glomerulus VP2.
modalities.citation: Gallio et al. 2011, Cell 144:614; Frank et al. 2015, Cell Rep 11:1345
modalities.notes: Only 7 TRN_VP2 neurons are present in v783.

modalities.label: Heat
modalities.description: Hot-activated thermoreceptor neurons projecting to glomerulus VP3.
modalities.notes: Only 9 TRN_VP3 neurons are present in v783.

dn_commands.behaviour: Giant Fibre. Drives short-mode escape: mesothoracic leg extension and takeoff within ~5 ms, without preparatory wing raising.
dn_commands.citation: von Reyn et al. 2014, Nat Neurosci 17:962-965; Card & Dickinson 2008, J Exp Biol 211:341-353

dn_commands.behaviour: Contributes to long-mode (GF-independent) escape with preparatory wing raising and a directed jump.
dn_commands.citation: Namiki et al. 2018, eLife 7:e34272; Cheong et al. 2024, eLife 13:RP96323

dn_commands.behaviour: Looming-responsive descending neuron in the escape network.
Escape-network descending neuron projecting to leg neuropils.
Steering: activity biases the fly's turning.
Steering: unilateral activity drives ipsilateral turning.
Moonwalker descending neuron: drives backward walking.
